title: Cryptopot
tagline: CryptoPot: Twitch streamers' gateway to crypto donations! EVM & L2 compatible, easy withdrawals, real-time stats 📈. Next up: ERC1620 subs!
description: CryptoPot offers a slick way for Twitch streamers to rake in crypto donations from anywhere, leveraging the full spectrum of EVM chains and L2 solutions. Streamers get a killer dashboard to track earnings and hit that withdraw button anytime. We're gearing up to drop ERC1620 subscriptions, turning one-time donations into steady cash flow.
how_its_made: React + TypeScript for a snappy front end, and a Mongo, Node.js, NestJS stack out back for speed and scale. Solidity and OpenZeppelin lay the blockchain foundation, with Dynamic Wallet making donations smooth like butter. We hooked Twitch up with real-time alerts straight from the blockchain, making every donation a hype moment. And with ERC1620, we're about to make recurring revenue a thing. CryptoPot's the bridge between streaming and crypto.
